description: GNU tar saves many files together into a single tape or disk archive, and can restore individual files from the archive.

option.name: --absolute-names
tip: don't strip leading '/'s from file names

option.name: --acls
tip: Enable the POSIX ACLs support

option.name: --add-file
tip: add given FILE to the archive (useful if its name starts with a dash)

option.name: --after-date
tip: only store files newer than DATE-OR-FILE

option.name: --anchored
tip: patterns match file name start

option.name: --append
tip: append files to the end of an archive

option.name: --atime-preserve
tip: preserve access times on dumped files
METHOD is replace (restore the times after reading, default) or system (do not set the times)

option.name: --auto-compress
tip: use archive suffix to determine the compression program

option.name: --backup
tip: back up files before removal
CONTROL is one of none/off, t/numbered, nil/existing, never/simple

option.name: --block-number
tip: show block number within archive with each message

option.name: --blocking-factor
tip: BLOCKS x 512 bytes per record

option.name: --bzip2
tip: filter the archive through bzip2

option.name: --check-device
tip: check device numbers when creating incremental archives (default)

option.name: --check-links
tip: print a message if not all links are dumped

option.name: --checkpoint
tip: display progress messages every NUMBERth record (default 10)

option.name: --checkpoint-action
tip: execute ACTION on each checkpoint
dot and totals are listed; other actions take parameters (echo=, exec=, sleep=, ttyout=)

next.name: dot
tip: Display a dot for each checkpoint.

next.name: totals
tip: Display cumulative totals at each checkpoint.

option.name: --clamp-mtime
tip: only set time when the file is more recent than what was given with --mtime

option.name: --compare
tip: find differences between archive and file system

option.name: --concatenate
tip: append tar files to an archive

option.name: --confirmation
tip: ask for confirmation for every action

option.name: --create
tip: create a new archive

option.name: --delay-directory-restore
tip: delay setting modification times and permissions of extracted directories until the end of extraction

option.name: --delete
tip: delete from the archive (not on mag tapes!)

option.name: --dereference
tip: follow symlinks; archive and dump the files they point to

option.name: --directory
tip: change to directory DIR

option.name: --exclude
tip: exclude files, given as a PATTERN

option.name: --exclude-backups
tip: exclude backup and lock files

option.name: --exclude-caches
tip: exclude contents of directories containing CACHEDIR.TAG, except for the tag file itself

option.name: --exclude-caches-all
tip: exclude directories containing CACHEDIR.TAG

option.name: --exclude-caches-under
tip: exclude everything under directories containing CACHEDIR.TAG

option.name: --exclude-from
tip: exclude patterns listed in FILE

option.name: --exclude-ignore
tip: read exclude patterns for each directory from FILE, if it exists

option.name: --exclude-ignore-recursive
tip: read exclude patterns for each directory and its subdirectories from FILE, if it exists

option.name: --exclude-tag
tip: exclude contents of directories containing FILE, except for FILE itself

option.name: --exclude-tag-all
tip: exclude directories containing FILE

option.name: --exclude-tag-under
tip: exclude everything under directories containing FILE

option.name: --exclude-vcs
tip: exclude version control system directories

option.name: --exclude-vcs-ignores
tip: read exclude patterns from the VCS ignore files

option.name: --extract
tip: extract files from an archive

option.name: --file
tip: use archive file or device ARCHIVE

option.name: --files-from
tip: get names to extract or create from FILE

option.name: --force-local
tip: archive file is local even if it has a colon

option.name: --format
tip: create archive of the given format
Possible values: gnu, oldgnu, pax, posix, ustar, v7

next.name: gnu
tip: GNU tar 1.13.x format.

next.name: oldgnu
tip: GNU format as per tar <= 1.12.

next.name: pax
tip: POSIX 1003.1-2001 (pax) format.

next.name: posix
tip: Same as pax.

next.name: ustar
tip: POSIX 1003.1-1988 (ustar) format.

next.name: v7
tip: Old V7 tar format.

option.name: --full-time
tip: print file time to its full resolution

option.name: --group
tip: force NAME as group for added files

option.name: --group-map
tip: use FILE to map file owner GIDs and names

option.name: --hard-dereference
tip: follow hard links; archive and dump the files they refer to

option.name: --help
tip: give this help list

option.name: --hole-detection
tip: technique to detect holes in sparse files
Possible values: raw, seek

next.name: raw
tip: Use raw reads.

next.name: seek
tip: Use seeking.

option.name: --ignore-case
tip: ignore case

option.name: --ignore-command-error
tip: ignore exit codes of children

option.name: --ignore-failed-read
tip: do not exit with nonzero on unreadable files

option.name: --ignore-zeros
tip: ignore zeroed blocks in archive (means EOF)

option.name: --incremental
tip: handle old GNU-format incremental backup

option.name: --index-file
tip: send verbose output to FILE

option.name: --keep-directory-symlink
tip: preserve existing symlinks to directories when extracting

option.name: --keep-newer-files
tip: don't replace existing files that are newer than their archive copies

option.name: --keep-old-files
tip: don't replace existing files when extracting, treat them as errors

option.name: --label
tip: create archive with volume name TEXT
at list or extract time, use TEXT as a globbing pattern for the volume name

option.name: --level
tip: dump level for created listed-incremental archive

option.name: --list
tip: list the contents of an archive

option.name: --listed-incremental
tip: handle new GNU-format incremental backup

option.name: --lzip
tip: filter the archive through lzip

option.name: --lzma
tip: filter the archive through xz

option.name: --lzop
tip: filter the archive through lzop

option.name: --mode
tip: force (symbolic) mode CHANGES for added files

option.name: --mtime
tip: set mtime for added files from DATE-OR-FILE

option.name: --multi-volume
tip: create/list/extract multi-volume archive

option.name: --new-volume-script
tip: run script at end of each tape (implies -M)

option.name: --newer-mtime
tip: compare date and time when data changed only

option.name: --no-acls
tip: Disable the POSIX ACLs support

option.name: --no-anchored
tip: patterns match after any '/' (default for exclusion)

option.name: --no-auto-compress
tip: do not use archive suffix to determine the compression program

option.name: --no-check-device
tip: do not check device numbers when creating incremental archives

option.name: --no-delay-directory-restore
tip: cancel the effect of --delay-directory-restore option

option.name: --no-ignore-case
tip: case sensitive matching (default)

option.name: --no-ignore-command-error
tip: treat non-zero exit codes of children as error

option.name: --no-null
tip: disable the effect of the previous --null option

option.name: --no-overwrite-dir
tip: preserve metadata of existing directories

option.name: --no-quote-chars
tip: disable quoting for characters from STRING

option.name: --no-recursion
tip: avoid descending automatically in directories

option.name: --no-same-owner
tip: extract files as yourself (default for ordinary users)

option.name: --no-same-permissions
tip: apply the user's umask when extracting permissions from the archive (default for ordinary users)

option.name: --no-seek
tip: archive is not seekable

option.name: --no-selinux
tip: Disable the SELinux context support

option.name: --no-unquote
tip: do not unquote input file or member names

option.name: --no-verbatim-files-from
tip: -T treats file names starting with dash as options (default)

option.name: --no-wildcards
tip: verbatim string matching

option.name: --no-wildcards-match-slash
tip: wildcards do not match '/'

option.name: --no-xattrs
tip: Disable extended attributes support

option.name: --null
tip: -T reads null-terminated names; implies --verbatim-files-from

option.name: --numeric-owner
tip: always use numbers for user/group names

option.name: --occurrence
tip: process only the NUMBERth occurrence of each file in the archive
valid only with --delete, --diff, --extract or --list, and when a file list is given on the command line or via -T
NUMBER defaults to 1

option.name: --one-file-system
tip: stay in local file system when creating archive

option.name: --one-top-level
tip: create a subdirectory to avoid having loose files extracted

option.name: --overwrite
tip: overwrite existing files when extracting

option.name: --overwrite-dir
tip: overwrite metadata of existing directories when extracting (default)

option.name: --owner
tip: force NAME as owner for added files

option.name: --owner-map
tip: use FILE to map file owner UIDs and names

option.name: --pax-option
tip: control pax keywords

option.name: --portability
tip: same as --format=v7

option.name: --posix
tip: same as --format=posix

option.name: --preserve-order
tip: member arguments are listed in the same order as the files in the archive

option.name: --preserve-permissions
tip: extract information about file permissions (default for superuser)

option.name: --quote-chars
tip: additionally quote characters from STRING

option.name: --quoting-style
tip: set name quoting style
Possible values: literal, shell, shell-always, shell-escape, shell-escape-always, c, c-maybe, escape, locale, clocale

option.name: --read-full-records
tip: reblock as we read (for 4.2BSD pipes)

option.name: --record-size
tip: NUMBER of bytes per record, multiple of 512

option.name: --recursion
tip: recurse into directories (default)

option.name: --recursive-unlink
tip: empty hierarchies prior to extracting directory

option.name: --remove-files
tip: remove files after adding them to the archive

option.name: --restrict
tip: disable use of some potentially harmful options

option.name: --rmt-command
tip: use given rmt COMMAND instead of rmt

option.name: --rsh-command
tip: use remote COMMAND instead of rsh

option.name: --same-owner
tip: try extracting files with the same ownership as exists in the archive (default for superuser)

option.name: --seek
tip: archive is seekable

option.name: --selinux
tip: Enable the SELinux context support

option.name: --show-defaults
tip: show tar defaults

option.name: --show-omitted-dirs
tip: when listing or extracting, list each directory that does not match search criteria

option.name: --show-snapshot-field-ranges
tip: show valid ranges for snapshot-file fields

option.name: --show-transformed-names
tip: show file or archive names after transformation

option.name: --skip-old-files
tip: don't replace existing files when extracting, silently skip over them

option.name: --sort
tip: directory sorting order for archive creation
Possible values: none, name, inode

next.name: inode
tip: Sort by inode.

next.name: name
tip: Sort by name.

next.name: none
tip: Default order.

option.name: --sparse
tip: handle sparse files efficiently

option.name: --sparse-version
tip: set version of the sparse format to use (implies --sparse)

option.name: --starting-file
tip: begin at member MEMBER-NAME when reading the archive

option.name: --strip-components
tip: strip NUMBER leading components from file names on extraction

option.name: --suffix
tip: override the usual backup suffix
the default is ~ unless SIMPLE_BACKUP_SUFFIX is set

option.name: --tape-length
tip: change tape after writing NUMBER x 1024 bytes

option.name: --test-label
tip: test the archive volume label and exit

option.name: --to-command
tip: pipe extracted files to another program

option.name: --to-stdout
tip: extract files to standard output

option.name: --totals
tip: print total bytes after processing the archive
with a SIGNAL argument, print totals when that signal is delivered
allowed signals: SIGHUP, SIGQUIT, SIGINT, SIGUSR1 and SIGUSR2; the SIG prefix may be omitted

option.name: --touch
tip: don't extract file modified time

option.name: --transform
tip: use sed replace EXPRESSION to transform file names

option.name: --uncompress
tip: filter the archive through compress

option.name: --ungzip
tip: filter the archive through gzip

option.name: --unlink-first
tip: remove each file prior to extracting over it

option.name: --unquote
tip: unquote input file or member names (default)

option.name: --update
tip: only append files newer than copy in archive

option.name: --usage
tip: give a short usage message

option.name: --use-compress-program
tip: filter through PROG (must accept -d)

option.name: --utc
tip: print file modification times in UTC

option.name: --verbatim-files-from
tip: -T reads file names verbatim (no escape or option handling)

option.name: --verbose
tip: verbosely list files processed

option.name: --verify
tip: attempt to verify the archive after writing it

option.name: --version
tip: print program version

option.name: --volno-file
tip: use/update the volume number in FILE

option.name: --warning
tip: enable or disable warning messages identified by KEYWORD
prefix a keyword with no- to disable it

Possible values: none, all, alone-zero-block, bad-dumpdir, cachedir, contiguous-cast, file-changed, file-ignored, file-removed, file-shrank, file-unchanged, filename-with-nuls, ignore-archive, ignore-newer, new-directory, rename-directory, symlink-cast, timestamp, unknown-cast, unknown-keyword, xdev, decompress-program, existing-file, xattr-write, record-size, failed-read, missing-zero-blocks, verbose

option.name: --wildcards
tip: use wildcards (default for exclusion)

option.name: --wildcards-match-slash
tip: wildcards match '/' (default for exclusion)

option.name: --xattrs
tip: Enable extended attributes support

option.name: --xattrs-exclude
tip: specify the exclude pattern for xattr keys

option.name: --xattrs-include
tip: specify the include pattern for xattr keys

option.name: --xz
tip: filter the archive through xz

option.name: --zstd
tip: filter the archive through zstd

option.name: -o
tip: when creating, same as --old-archive; when extracting, same as --no-same-owner
